title: LRU Cache
description: lru cache: get(k) returns the value or nullopt, update(k, v) sets/refreshes; capacity via init.
interface: update(k, v) -> void get(k) -> int|null size() -> int
example: cap 2: update a=1, b=2, get a -> 1, update c=3 evicts b

members: struct Node { string key; int val; Node* prev; Node* next; };
methods: void update(const string& k, int v)
